external_collaboration.evidence_quote: 80 students from Mallow Campus have the opportunity to take part in work placements in Spain, France, Sweden and Poland each year. Work placements are organised through a network of contacts with Spanish, French, Polish and Swedish enterprises in a wide variety of industry sectors. Benefits for Students Erasmus+ opportunities are very beneficial to students, who gain valuable experience in terms of learning new language and technical skills but also in terms of personal growth.
